end.summary:
Practised factorising x² + px + q by finding two numbers with a required product and sum.
Arjun gave 5 correct unaided responses out of 7 attempts.
They worked with positive and negative integer pairs and checked sums and products.
They initially copied coefficients in one expression; this was corrected later in the lesson.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised finding two numbers whose product and sum match the quadratic, then writing the factors. They used product and sum checks successfully in several examples, including negative pairs. They once copied the coefficients directly in [x + 5)(x + 6), but later corrected this method by checking the required product and sum. At home, practise a few examples by writing the product and sum beside each chosen pair before forming the brackets.
